evidence: Labeled 'Mining', touches the mining interface implementation in src/node/block_template_manager.*, and updates mining Cap'n Proto definitions.
rationale: Resolves a data race where concurrent IPC worker threads access `CBlockTemplate` during `submitSolution()` while another thread reads it (#36515). It also stabilizes the external mining interface by adding a direct `getTotalFees()` getter so clients do not have to iterate transactions across the boundary.
